notes.title: Minor QoL update.
URGENT: COPY YOUR DATA PRIOR TO NEXT UPDATE
notes.content:
Urgent message!
This is not the way we would prefer to do it, but we have no other options. In 24 hours, we will update the game. This new update will store your save data in C:\\Games\\soul_interface instead of the game folder, which is C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Steam\\steamapps\\common\\soul Interface. Unfortunately, this will ERAZE your save data unless you copy it. To do that, go to the steam directory (C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Steam\\steamapps\\common\\soul Interface), copy sys, local, user, guide.txt, world_database files, as well as chromosome, nervous_system and molecule folders and move them to a separate location. Once the game updates, in EXACTLY 24 hours, you will be able to copy them to C:\\Games\\soul_interface and continue playing. We apologize for this inconvenience and urgency. This will ensure your datasafety and make certain that something like this can't happen again. Again, in 24 hours the game will be updated - copy your save files or you'll lose then!

notes.title: PvP MULTIPLAYER + VOICEACTING + MUSIC + TUTORIAL REWORK
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45016745/c6aba2740ad6464dc5137af2ccb7c943f7f72cc8.jpg"]

1. Online PvP Multiplayer.
You can now package your chromosomes into spaceships and send them to other players' simulations to syphon their energy. Here is how it works:
1.1 Someone shoots a projectile at you containing an invasive species they designed;
1.2 Their chromosome spawns into creatures, killing your organisms, eating your energy and
sending it to the player that made it;
1.3 You design a creature that counters the invasive species and saves your ecosystem;
1.4 You now also have a species to shoot back with!

2. New linear storyline, Tutorial and Guides.
We have reworked the tutorial, created dedicated manuals for designing different species, making them move, hunt and reproduce; The rework includes new scripted voiceacted events, speaking of which...

3. Full Voiceacting.
We are so very excited to have the wonderful and brilliant Wonda White as the voice of the helper!

4. Musical score.
SI now has a musical OST by our amazing new composer, Geoffrey Guyer, whose work, including SI score, you can find at: [dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/@geoffrey6265"][/dynamiclink] 

As usual, let us know of any bugs or possible improvements, and join our community on Discord: https://discord.gg/f3Jvu5Mw55

notes.title: RECORD YOUR ECOSYSTEM
Release to Early Access
notes.content:
We are ever so thrilled to have the game out and available for purchase!
This version features organism creation and training, a full ecosystem cycle, and new mechanics that will allow you to prepare for multiplayer and try creating competitive, efficient organisms that will collect energy for you! It also features rocket mail as a prototype of what multiplayer will eventually be like... 

TO THOSE OF YOU WHO PLAYED THE DEMO: you can safely transfer your save file to the full game without missing out on any new content, if you wish.

Exciting times ahead, here is a ROADMAP of the features we will be working on next:
| Casual multiplayer: exchange packages between worlds
| Two new arms for reviewing chromosome stats and the ecosystem
| New types of trainable creatures
| Lore media-sequences

Speaking of lore, did you know that soul Interface has a lot of it? That's right - if you want to know more and understand less about all this, you can check out the media section on our website for some short horror stories set in the SI universe!

Want even more content? May we interest you in High-Res illustrations for said lore? Concept art for the game? Here is how to get it:
1. Draw fanart or make other media about SI
2, Join our Discord and share what you made

> > >
